name: NLCD_LndChg
description: NLCD_LndChg provides labeled examples for detecting land-cover change derived from NLCD (National Land Cover Database) products. It is intended for remote-sensing change-detection and segmentation tasks over time using satellite/land-cover map inputs. The dataset supports evaluation of automated change-detection pipelines and models for environmental monitoring.
reputation: Used in remote-sensing and land-change research with moderate adoption among environmental ML practitioners.
